info.title: Operation Borderless API
info.description: Multi-currency stablecoin wallet sandbox. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`. Any route can also return NOT_FOUND (404), METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (405), PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (413), RETRY_LATER (503, with Retry-After) or INTERNAL_ERROR (500). Amounts are strings with 6 decimals; timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

phone.description: Parsed with region NG by default

quote_id.description: Execute at the rate locked by POST /v1/fx/quotes (single use, short-lived)

destination_currency.description: Coin the recipient receives; defaults to source_currency

amount.description: Exact amount of source_currency to send: decimal string, up to 6 decimals

quote_id.description: Execute at the rate locked by POST /v1/fx/quotes (single use, short-lived)

amount.description: Exact amount of from_currency to sell: decimal string, up to 6 decimals
